claim: Bbl article 7.9 requires an asbestos-inventory report for demolition work on a part known or suspected to contain asbestos; pre-1994 buildings create the presumption; post-1 January 1994 buildings and linked non-certified-company or private-removal cases can be excepted; the customer gives the contractor a copy before removal.
IPLO says the project owner or coordinator commissions the inventory, the inventory worker investigates and reports, and findings must be registered in LAVS.
The process-scheme amendment was published on 26 August 2026, took effect the next day, updated the NEN 2990 reference and was described as limited with no administrative-load effect.
The current scheme requires an asbestos-inventory company to have at least one DIA working under an employment contract; inventory work is performed by a DIA.
The technical final responsible person must be a DIA, meet an experience or annual-work condition, know the quality system and sign the inventory report.

The certificate-holder must immediately report changes of directors, management, owner and UBO; a process certificate lasts at most three years; each branch is reviewed annually with at least four completed files examined.

The scheme requires a tailored documented quality system with defined roles and replacement arrangements, document and internal-review controls, procurement controls, safety instructions and corrective-action procedures; inventory reports and related data are retained for at least ten years.
The scheme separates asbestos inventory from removal ownership and generally bars one UBO or director from two inventory firms unless concern-level DIA and report thresholds are met.

The scheme requires announced and unannounced project-site assessments, uses the criterion producing the higher count, requires four yearly assessments for 1–2 DIAs and under 500 reports, and six for 3–5 DIAs or 500–1,100 reports.
Ascert's live register showed 155 asbestos-inventory companies and 798 DIA certificates; it says most personal certificates last three years.
